transcript_segments.text: Taste, taste, taste
Refine, acquired
Does it?
You say you've tried everything once
The collected flavors like stamps
Maped your tongue across continents
Measure depth and grams
You speak in confident lines
Draw a boundary
Call it true
If it doesn't sit where you expect
You say there's nothing to it
You lean back, simplify
Reduce the world to a choice
See that it lands inside your grid
Or it dissolves to noise
But I hear shapes in the blur
Little patterns you'd differ
In the space between dimensions
There's a signal you don't mention
